blocks.text:
Swipe between Home pages and they turn around their middle, as if Home were printed on a turning drum. Pages keep their full size; the camera sits far back so the turn stays gentle.

Install it, then choose it in Settings › Gestures › Page Effects. Pages slide flat while you move an app or resize a widget, and Reduce Motion turns every page effect off. Removing the package puts back the built-in effect you had.

Inspired by Barrel by Aaron Ash. Re-created from scratch for Folio; no tweak code is included.
